messages.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
For an AI data center use case, a Vector Network Analyzer fits mainly in the hardware interconnect test workflow: PCB / PCBA high-speed channel validation, server-board IL / TDR / high-speed trace tests, connector / cable tests, and some PDN or optical / SiPh-related network-analysis contexts.[8][11][57][58][92]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where VNA fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AI data center hardware connectivity | AI / data center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber, power, and cooling, so VNA-related testing maps to the electrical / optical interconnect and board-level portions, not the cooling or mechanical portions.[8] | [8] |
| PCB fabrication / system-house PCB workflow | The PCB test flow includes material measurement, material / stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling / testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring; the listed measurements include impedance / TDR, DK / DF, IL, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram.[3][43] | [3][43] |
| Server PCB / board test | R&S ZNA and ZNB are mapped to server circuit board / PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA is also mapped to server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace test.[11][57] | [11][57] |
| High-speed channel / interconnect validation | The SI / SerDes validation context includes transmission channels made of Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, and connectors, and the signal-integrity flow lists IL, Xtalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner, and TL calculator.[38][92] | [38][92] |
| Cable / connector test | R&S ZNA / ZNB plus OSP are mapped to connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and VNA with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner is described for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems.[48][57] | [48][57] |
| PDN / power-integrity workflow | In the SerDes / SI-PI overview, the Power Distribution Network block is connected to scopes and network analyzers; in the AI server mapping, R&S ZNL is listed for PDN Target Z on server motherboard / PCBA.[57][92] | [57][92] |
| Optical / SiPh / CPO-related workflow | The AI server mapping lists optical VNA using R&S ZNA / ZNB with PSA / ThinkLands or GOCA / Newkey in the silicon photonics category, while noting this is a sales-mapping clue and not a formal application note.[58][60] | [58][60] |
### Practical placement
Place the VNA after architecture / stackup planning and before or during validation, where the team needs measured channel data such as insertion loss, impedance / TDR, and high-speed trace or cable / connector behavior on PCB / PCBA interconnects.[11][43][57][92]
For production-facing PCB workflows, it can also appear in sampling testing and process monitoring contexts where IL, DK / DF, and impedance are listed, but the source does not provide control limits, sampling rules, fixture details, or calibration methods.[1][46]
### R&S product mapping caveat
R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series up to 67 GHz, R&S ZNB3000 is a Vector Network Analyzer series with base frequency range up to 43.5 GHz and upgrade option to 54.0 GHz, and R&S ZNL is a 2-port Vector Network Analyzer series up to 20 GHz.[17][21][23]
The AI server ecosystem mapping links R&S ZNA / ZNB / ZNL to test-entry points such as IL, TDR, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, optical VNA, and PDN Target Z, but it is only a sales / test-solution mapping and not a formal datasheet, application note, configuration guide, or ordering guide.[57][58][59][60]

- Frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 在 measurement 與 calibration 時必須相同。
- 不允許 interpolation。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。

- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。

R&S ZNA › 2-port / 4-port 架構
依 [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（Version 24.00, April 2026）：

- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 4-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 8 true receivers；2-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 4 true receivers；來源明確說明無 multiplexing。
- 支援 true parallel and coherent data acquisition，例如 antenna array tests 與 antenna test systems，從 100 kHz 開始。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator。
- Rear panel LO out 提供 high-power LO signal，typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz，可作為 mixer measurements 的 LO source。
- Optional second LO source 可讓 mixer/frequency convertor measurements 速度加倍並最佳化 trace noise。
- 使用 [[R&S ZNA-K9]] option、1 kHz measurement bandwidth 時，mixer group delay 與 deviation from linear phase 的 group delay trace noise peak-to-peak 可由 200 ps 降至 15 ps。
- 最多 4 pulse modulators、最多 8 pulse generators（4-port）；最多 2 pulse modulators、最多 4 pulse generators（2-port）。
- Minimum pulse width：40 ns。
- Optional direct IF access（in/out）：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
- Selectable reference signal access：1 GHz external reference，可同步 external equipment，例如 signal generators，改善 mmWave converters up to terahertz frequencies 的 performance。

R&S ZNB3000 › Dynamic range 條件
- Receiver noise floor 定義為 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS 值，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，test ports short-circuited。
- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

### Short answer
For an AI data center use case, a Vector Network Analyzer fits mainly in the hardware interconnect test workflow: PCB / PCBA high-speed channel validation, server-board IL / TDR / high-speed trace tests, connector / cable tests, and some PDN or optical / SiPh-related network-analysis contexts.[8][11][57][58][92]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where VNA fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AI data center hardware connectivity | AI / data center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber, power, and cooling, so VNA-related testing maps to the electrical / optical interconnect and board-level portions, not the cooling or mechanical portions.[8] | [8] |
| PCB fabrication / system-house PCB workflow | The PCB test flow includes material measurement, material / stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling / testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring; the listed measurements include impedance / TDR, DK / DF, IL, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram.[3][43] | [3][43] |
| Server PCB / board test | R&S ZNA and ZNB are mapped to server circuit board / PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA is also mapped to server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace test.[11][57] | [11][57] |
| High-speed channel / interconnect validation | The SI / SerDes validation context includes transmission channels made of Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, and connectors, and the signal-integrity flow lists IL, Xtalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner, and TL calculator.[38][92] | [38][92] |
| Cable / connector test | R&S ZNA / ZNB plus OSP are mapped to connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and VNA with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner is described for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems.[48][57] | [48][57] |
| PDN / power-integrity workflow | In the SerDes / SI-PI overview, the Power Distribution Network block is connected to scopes and network analyzers; in the AI server mapping, R&S ZNL is listed for PDN Target Z on server motherboard / PCBA.[57][92] | [57][92] |
| Optical / SiPh / CPO-related workflow | The AI server mapping lists optical VNA using R&S ZNA / ZNB with PSA / ThinkLands or GOCA / Newkey in the silicon photonics category, while noting this is a sales-mapping clue and not a formal application note.[58][60] | [58][60] |
### Practical placement
Place the VNA after architecture / stackup planning and before or during validation, where the team needs measured channel data such as insertion loss, impedance / TDR, and high-speed trace or cable / connector behavior on PCB / PCBA interconnects.[11][43][57][92]
For production-facing PCB workflows, it can also appear in sampling testing and process monitoring contexts where IL, DK / DF, and impedance are listed, but the source does not provide control limits, sampling rules, fixture details, or calibration methods.[1][46]
### R&S product mapping caveat
R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series up to 67 GHz, R&S ZNB3000 is a Vector Network Analyzer series with base frequency range up to 43.5 GHz and upgrade option to 54.0 GHz, and R&S ZNL is a 2-port Vector Network Analyzer series up to 20 GHz.[17][21][23]
The AI server ecosystem mapping links R&S ZNA / ZNB / ZNL to test-entry points such as IL, TDR, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, optical VNA, and PDN Target Z, but it is only a sales / test-solution mapping and not a formal datasheet, application note, configuration guide, or ordering guide.[57][58][59][60]

[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

R&S PCB test solutions › 可追溯限制
- 本來源沒有提供正式 R&S 產品型號、option code、license、測試頻率、測試標準、fixture 或 calibration method。
- 本頁不把 Slide 21 的圖上列名解讀為正式解決方案型錄或完整採購配置。
- [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]] 的角色未明，僅保留圖上列名。
- [[ISD-ADK]] 與 PL 未展開縮寫，需後續來源補證。

高速互連 probing 與 de-embedding 測試案例
[[高速互連 probing 與 de-embedding 測試案例]] 是從 [[TRI_AMD_RSKR Sharing1]] 抽出的 Market 層級案例集合，描述以 VNA、probe、mount-kit、de-embedding tool 與 local partner 解決 PCB、socket、connector 與 SoC validation 量測問題。
